entities.name: Early Human Migration
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The gradual dispersal of Homo sapiens from Africa to every continent over tens of thousands of years, driven by climate, resources, and curiosity. This migration shaped the genetic and cultural diversity of all human populations.
